name: 3-Ingredient Devils on Horseback

ingredients.name: center-cut bacon slices, cut in half crosswise

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven racks to upper-middle and lower-middle positions, and preheat oven to 400°F. Line 3 rimmed baking sheets with aluminum foil. Arrange bacon halves in a single layer on 2 prepared baking sheets. Bake both sheets at same time until edges begin to curl and fat begins to render, 8 to 10 minutes, rotating sheets halfway through baking. Let cool on baking sheet until cool enough to handle, about 5 minutes.
While bacon cooks, use a paring knife to cut a slit lengthwise in each date to create an opening, taking care not to cut all the way through.
Stuff each date with about 3/4 teaspoon blue cheese; press lightly to pack in, then pinch to close.
Wrap 1 cooled bacon half around each stuffed date. Secure with toothpick, if needed, and arrange seam-side down on the remaining prepared baking sheet.
Bake on lower-middle rack until bacon is browned and crisp, 12 to 14 minutes, rotating baking sheet halfway through. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

schema_metadata.keywords: devils on horseback recipe, bacon wrapped dates recipe, holiday party appetizer recipe

description: These three-ingredient devils on horseback—blue-cheese-stuffed dates wrapped in bacon—bake up sweet, salty, and perfectly crisp. They’re an easy holiday appetizer that can even be made ahead and baked just before serving.
notes: Make-ahead and storage: The dates can be stuffed with the blue cheese, wrapped in the parcooked bacon, and refrigerated, covered on a plate or in an airtight container, for up to 3 days before cooking and serving.
author: Leah Colins
